name: Paperclip
tagline: Self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents
description: Paperclip is an open-source self-hosted board for managing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. Assign work to agents, run them, and track cost and output from a single dashboard.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Better auth secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  paperclip:
    image: ghcr.io/paperclipai/paperclip:latest@sha256:66056e8c979bc2f8ef35083ebd333b7c83224fe3234bd92d251b0bbce1054317
    container_name: paperclip
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3100"
    environment:
      PORT: "3100"
      HOST: 0.0.0.0
      SERVE_UI: "true"
      PAPERCLIP_HOME: /paperclip
      PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL: http://localhost:3101
      PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE: authenticated
      PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE: private
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ${SECRET_BETTER_AUTH_SECRET}
      PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET: ${SECRET_BETTER_AUTH_SECRET}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ""
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ""
      GEMINI_API_KEY: ""
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ""
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/paperclip
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://localhost:3100/api/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - paperclip_network
networks:
  paperclip_network:
    driver: bridge
notes: This app ships with placeholder secrets so it starts without configuration. They are the same for every install and are not secret. Replace BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET with 'openssl rand -hex 32' before using it for anything real. Also change PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL from localhost to the exact address and port you browse to, for example http://192.168.1.50:3101: the port is 3101 on most platforms but 10201 on Umbrel, and sign-in callbacks fail while it is wrong. See the app README.
